meta.description: Turns paths into the surface around them with a fibrous relief along them. Every node that made paths is its own material group. Paths and meshes from set_color bring their color, the color goes over smoothly where paths of two colors meet.

hyphae.label: Body
hyphae.description: Paths that grow into one body of tissue, like stipe and cap: the gaps between them fill

loose.label: Loose
loose.description: Paths that stay apart, like gills and the veil: they join where they touch, the gaps between them stay open

fibres.description: Relief along the paths, fibrous on the body, faint on loose paths. Paths from set_fibres bring their own.

blend.description: How far, in path radii, neighbouring paths join into one surface. Paths from set_blend bring their own.

fill.description: Where a ball of this many path radii can't pass between body paths the gap fills, so single paths only show as fibres. 0 shows every path. Paths from set_fill bring their own.

meshes.label: Meshes
meshes.description: Meshes added as they are, like the plates of lamellae or the skin of membrane: one mesh, or a list of them from a join node. Each one is its own group, after the groups of the paths, and keeps its color from set_color.

loose_strands.description: Body paths that leave the surface: 0 = none, the surface is closed tissue, 1 = every one stays a strand. In between the tissue takes in a strand that stays closer to it than (1 / value - 1) times its half thickness there, so a thick stipe takes in longer strays than a thin cap margin.
